name: JoAi: Send Campaign Test

description.en: Send a test of an existing draft campaign to one contact (email) or one install (push) without attaching them to the campaign audience.
description.de: Sende einen Test einer bestehenden Entwurfskampagne an einen Kontakt (E-Mail) oder eine Installation (Push), ohne sie der Zielgruppe hinzuzufügen.
description.fr: Envoyez un test d'une campagne brouillon à un contact (e-mail) ou une installation (push) sans les ajouter à l'audience.
description.es: Envía una prueba de una campaña borrador a un contacto (email) o una instalación (push) sin añadirlos a la audiencia.
description.it: Invia un test di una campagna bozza a un contatto (email) o un'installazione (push) senza aggiungerli al pubblico.
description.ro: Trimite un test al unei campanii schiță către un contact (email) sau o instalare (push), fără a-i adăuga în audiență.

bot: Use to smoke-test a draft before send. For email pass contactId; for push pass installId (from List Installs). Exactly one of contactId or installId is required.

description.en: Hashid of the draft campaign to test

inputs.name: Contact ID
inputs.bot: Required for email channel tests (contact must have an email).

inputs.name: Install ID
inputs.bot: Required for push channel tests. Get from List Installs (subscribed).

description.en: Team slug. Defaults to the current team.
